say:1:1033423001:1.text: Anything to help restore the forest to its previous prosperity.
say:1:1033423001:1.source_cn: 什么都行，只能能让丛林恢复之前的繁荣。
say:1:1033423001:1.male: Anything to help restore the forest to its previous prosperity.
say:1:1033423001:1.female: Anything to help restore the forest to its previous prosperity.

say:2:1033423002:1.text: I used to think I knew the forest inside out, but it took almost losing it to make me realize how intricately I had yet to explore its depths.
say:2:1033423002:1.source_cn: 之前的我总觉得对丛林的一切都了若指掌，可直到几乎失去它...
say:2:1033423002:1.male: I used to think I knew the forest inside out, but it took almost losing it to make me realize how intricately I had yet to explore its depths.
say:2:1033423002:1.female: I used to think I knew the forest inside out, but it took almost losing it to make me realize how intricately I had yet to explore its depths.

say:3:1033423003:1.text: I will always remember this feeling and take good care of our homeland.
say:3:1033423003:1.source_cn: 我会记住这份心情，好好珍惜保护家园。
say:3:1033423003:1.male: I will always remember this feeling and take good care of our homeland.
say:3:1033423003:1.female: I will always remember this feeling and take good care of our homeland.
